newsitem.title: USA: American Health DTCA contracts raise costs.
newsitem.headline: American Health DTCA contracts raise costs.

text.p: American Healthcorp Inc said on Friday that startup costs for comprehensive healthcare management contracts could temporarily hurt the near-term profitability of its diabetes treatment centers.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Thomas Cigarran said in a statement: "The revenues from these contracts will be more heavily weighted toward the later years of their initial five-year terms and for the first year after the commencement of each individual contract site location, we expect it to produce revenues slightly less than operating expenses."
